en: The postcard is divided into three sections: The top left shows a band of musicians in colorful folk costumes playing traditional instruments. The top right features a dancer in a bright pink costume performing in front of a group of musicians and a decorative wagon, evoking a festive outdoor scene. The lower section displays several brightly lit high-rise buildings at night. The main highlighted text in Cyrillic (Бар Цигански Табор) translates to 'Bar Gypsy Camp.' The design and typography evoke a mid-to-late 20th-century style.
